instruction: Begin by reviewing gui_015_gear_blank.step in SolidWorks, an 80 mm diameter, 10 mm thick gear disk blank with an existing 12 mm center hole. For this workflow, open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_015_gear_blank.step`. Do not create real involute teeth. Instead cut six through sector-shaped lightening windows through the disk thickness. The first window is centered on the +X axis at 0 degrees; each window is symmetric about its radial centerline, spans radii 22 mm to 32 mm, and has angular width 24 degrees (12 degrees on each side of the centerline). Place the remaining five window centerlines every 60 degrees around the Z axis. Keep the 12 mm center hole and preserve the 80 mm outside diameter and 10 mm thickness. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_015_gear_lightened_out.step.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
